let k' := k
let n' := n
let hk0' := hk0
let p := Nat.Prime.exists_prime_ge (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos' n)
obtain ⟨p, hp, hge⟩ := p
have h1 : p ≡ 1 [MOD k] := by
  let m := k
  have h2 : m ≠ 0 := hk0'
  have h3 : p ≥ m + 1 := hge
  have h4 : p ≥ m := h3
  have h5 : p % m = 1 := by
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_ge (h4)]
    exact Nat.sub_right_inj (Nat.le_refl m) (Nat.sub_self m)
  exact h5
exact ⟨p, hp, hge, h1⟩
